name: aggregates global and per-country rankings independently
input: plays for the same tracks in the US and DE, with timestamps and users ignored
test:
from copy import deepcopy
events = [
    {'user_id': 'u1', 'track_id': 'alpha', 'timestamp': '2026-01-01', 'country': 'US'},
    {'user_id': 'u2', 'track_id': 'alpha', 'timestamp': '2026-01-02', 'country': 'US'},
    {'user_id': 'u3', 'track_id': 'beta', 'timestamp': '2026-01-03', 'country': 'US'},
    {'user_id': 'u4', 'track_id': 'beta', 'timestamp': '2026-01-04', 'country': 'US'},
    {'user_id': 'u5', 'track_id': 'beta', 'timestamp': '2026-01-05', 'country': 'DE'},
    {'user_id': 'u6', 'track_id': 'beta', 'timestamp': '2026-01-06', 'country': 'DE'},
    {'user_id': 'u7', 'track_id': 'gamma', 'timestamp': '2026-01-07', 'country': 'DE'},
]
original = deepcopy(events)
assert top_played_tracks(events, 2) == {
    'global': [('beta', 4), ('alpha', 2)],
    'by_country': {
        'DE': [('beta', 2), ('gamma', 1)],
        'US': [('alpha', 2), ('beta', 2)],
    },
}
assert events == original
